vetSays.line: A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
A person, maybe 20s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
🌱 A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek looks over the garden: turned soil, nothing planted. Someone has to sow first.
💧 A person, maybe 20s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
📋 A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 20s, with a burn-scarred forearm hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
🍂 A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek gathers deadfall — 1 stick. The pile grows. (1 sticks now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek telling A person, maybe 40s, with ink-stained fingers about Nicole. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek: "If we rotate the watch, nobody pulls two nights running. Fair's fair."
🪨 A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (1 stone now.)
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek: "Right. Let's do it, then. Talking doesn't chop wood."
🍲 A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.
📋 A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek gathers deadfall — 1 stick + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (5 sticks now.)
the person in their 20s, with a scarred cheek spent the afternoon at the workbench and made 5 Crossbow bolt — and carries them now, their own work in their own hands.
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek: "We need more firewood before dark. Who's with me?"

🌿 A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~7 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the stone pile instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪨 A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (1 stone now.)
A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek sets out to find Nicole. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
📋 A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
💧 A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek eyes the cistern — full to the brim. No sense hauling water there's no room for; they turn to the stone pile instead.
🪨 A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (2 stone now.)
🚶 A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek is back — found Nicole.
A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek sets out to hunt the something. "It was there. Going back for it." Better close to the fire today.
A person, maybe 20s, with a scarred cheek showed Oliver the Burdock — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
🛡️ Nicole, Saul, Birgitte, Sung and Stan met them at the door — 5 put down. Nicole, Saul, Birgitte, Sung are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carlos just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Stan just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nicole, Axel, Birgitte, Stan and Carlos met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Nicole, Axel, Birgitte, Stan, Carlos are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nicole just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nicole just put down The Strike... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nicole just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
